resources.string: AI learning
AI learning

Once a day, after the strap’s first sync, your own DeepSeek key reads your history and keeps a short profile of how your body works. It may ask for small changes to how Energy is worked out. The app tries each one on your last days first, applies it only if those days still look plausible, and lets you undo it. Nothing stored changes, and your sleep scores and Readiness weights are never touched.

AI learning: what is sent, and where

With AI learning on, OpenStrap also sends the data below to %1$s, with your own key, once a day after the strap’s first sync. It never sends during a workout, and you can turn it off here at any time.

Your history, compressed: each of the last 90 days, weekly averages up to a year back and monthly averages before that, of sleep, bed and wake times, Recovery, HRV, resting heart rate, skin temperature, breathing rate, load and steps. Also the last 14 nights and workouts in detail.

The profile it wrote the day before (it also goes with Analyse now while AI learning is on), the comparisons the app works out, what the self-check found in the last days and the Energy tuning in force.
Up to %1$s KB a request. The profile it keeps is at most %2$s KB and stays on this phone.

What it may change: only the five Energy tuning values. The app tries each on your last days first, moves it at most a quarter of its range a day, fades it out in 14 days and lets you undo it. It may suggest your sleep need, but only you change it. It never edits stored data, sleep scores or Readiness weights.
